economic_hypothesis: In a causal broad bull market whose short breadth is at least its long breadth, an industry that moves from the lower half to the top 30% of twenty-session performance can represent fresh capital rotation. A stock's first twenty-session high breakout on expanded turnover is the simple executable expression of that rotation.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open

industry.emergence: ret20 percentile >=0.70 and same-industry t-5 percentile <=0.50

state.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
state.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
state.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
state.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

stock.first_breakout: current close >= prior20 high and previous close < its then-prior20 high
